definitions.explanation: A wheeled vehicle used for transporting goods, typically pulled by hand or by an animal.

examples.japanese: {荷車|にぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
⟦{牛|うし}→牛：01857_ushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{荷車|にぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: An ox pulled a cart along the road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{荷車|にぐるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}んで→積む：02294_tsumu⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{運|はこ}んでいた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: In the old days, farmers loaded vegetables onto carts and transported them to the market.

notes:
{荷車|にぐるま} is a compound of ⟦{荷|に}→荷：28294_ni⟧ (load, cargo) and ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (vehicle, wheel). It refers to a simple wheeled vehicle for hauling goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {荷車|にぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (pull a cart)
- {荷車|にぐるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧ (load onto a cart)
- {荷車|にぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (push a cart)

The word evokes a traditional or historical setting, as modern transportation has largely replaced carts. It appears frequently in historical fiction and descriptions of rural life.
